method: One 10,000-row CSV import into 10,000 existing records; parse, preview, classification, atomic commit and exact verification; human review time excluded
limitations: One observation, not a P95 claim.
Input bytes are prepared in memory; external provider/download latency and human review time are excluded.
The timed pipeline includes parse, two previews/classification, atomic commit and exact verification into 20,000 final events.
PSS is sampled after verification rather than continuously measuring a peak.
